title: Wine Tours in Kelowna
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Wine Tours in the Okanagan Valley are the most fun and exciting tours. The scenery here is gorgeous with mountains as far as the eye can see and beautiful lakes. Most of the wineries are on the lake or have a view of the lake. The wineries are welcoming and have the most amazing, friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our guides are experienced, fun and make your day one to remember. No matter which tour you choose you will be happy as they are all fantastic. Why choose a wine tour with us? We go out of our way to make this the best experience for our customers as we hope to host you again.
